feeds.title: The Good Trade
feeds.description: The Good Trade is the premier digital destination for sustainable fashion and lifestyle content and a trusted resource for vetted shopping recommendations. The articles here provide a helpful starting point in the journey towards a sustainable life. Explore trending fashion, tips for mindful living, articles, recent news, careers, and more.

feeds.title: UCLA Sustainability Blog
feeds.description: The UCLA Sustainability Committee is a dedicated group of faculty, staff, and students working collaboratively to advance sustainable practices and initiatives across the campus. Explore the stories of local champions driving climate action on UCLA's campuses, sustainability news, campus announcements, job opportunities, and more from their blog.

feeds.title: The Niles Foundation Blog
feeds.description: The Niles Foundation is a nonprofit mobilizing access to land, food, clean energy, education, training, leadership & environmental change to meet the every day basic needs of our communities. Read about their latest programs and outreach in the articles published here.

feeds.title: USCDornsife Blog
feeds.description: Stay current with the latest news headlines and opinions concerning environmental and sustainability realms. Follow up-to-date and objective analysis of all recent events. The USC Wrigley Institute for Environment & Sustainability inspires global environmental solutions through frontier education and research.

feeds.title: IoES Magazine
feeds.description: Visit the IoES blog that promises solutions for the broader world - and publishes its newest ideas, projects, news, articles, updates, and more about sustainability.

feeds.title: U.S Green Building Council Los Angeles Blog
feeds.description: Find out first about industry news, upcoming events, and updates from USGBC-LA's newsroom. The USGBC is a national non-profit that aims to promote sustainability in Southern California's built environment by delivering access to knowledge, resources, recognition, and networking.

feeds.title: University of Louisiana at Lafayette Sustainability Blog
feeds.description: Catch updates and inspiration from the Office of Sustainability at University of Louisiana at Lafayette. Stay informed and aware of the happening impacts on the environment and community, at the institutional level as well as a personal level.

feeds.title: Mommy Greenest
feeds.description: Mommy Greenest is a personal blog written and edited by Rachel Lincoln Sarnoff. She writes about healthy living, green news & events, eco beauty, and fashion.

feeds.title: Cero Waste Cindy Blog
feeds.description: Cindy Villaseñor is a educator, activist, environmental advocate, plant-lover and adorer of the outdoors. Passionate about helping others start a sustainability journey in a way that is practical, Cindy pins down her thoughts and ideas to reduce waste through her blog.
